description: Condos around a point in Bangkok, such as an office, a school, a residence or a station, given as lat/lng or as a place name or address. Same filters as search_condos plus radius_km, sorted by distance or by walk to a station. Returns bkkradar.com links.

lang.description: Language of the titles and links: en, fr, th, ja (Japanese) or zh (simplified Chinese). Use the user's language.

limit.description: Listings to return, 20 by default, 50 at most.

max_lease_months.description: Rentals that accept a lease this short, at most, in months (1 to 6): 6 for a DTV stay of 180 days. Prices are then that lease's monthly rent when the post gives it, often higher.

max_price.description: Maximum price in THB (per month for rent).

max_walk_minutes.description: Walk to the listing's nearest BTS/MRT station, at most, in minutes (straight line at 80 m a minute). With a station or line and no value: 12 (1 km).

min_size_sqm.description: Living area, at least, in m².

place.description: Address or place in Bangkok instead of lat/lng: an office, a school, a station, a residence.

property_kind.description: Kind of property; any for all.

radius_km.description: Distance from the point, at most, in km (straight line).

sort.description: distance (closest to the point first) or station_walk (closest to a station first).

name: nearby_condos
title: Condos near a place
